name: vanguard-skin
description: Local-first portfolio dashboard for tracking Vanguard and IBKR investments
author: itsme188

scripts.electron:copy-static: cp -r .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static && cp -r public .next/standalone/public && node scripts/deref-standalone-symlinks.js && rm -f .next/standalone/.env.local .next/standalone/.env .next/standalone/.env.production
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:compile && npm run electron:copy-static && electron .
scripts.electron:build: rm -rf dist && npm run build && npm run electron:compile && npm run electron:copy-static
scripts.electron:deploy: npm run electron:pack && npm run electron:install
scripts.electron:install: osascript -e 'tell application "/Applications/Vanguard Dashboard.app" to quit' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -rf "/Applications/Vanguard Dashboard.app" && cp -R "dist/mac-arm64/Vanguard Dashboard.app" /Applications/ && echo '✅ Installed to /Applications' && open "/Applications/Vanguard Dashboard.app"
